description.en: You are given N activities with their start and finish times. Select the maximum number of activities that can be performed by a single person, assuming that a person can only work on a single activity at a time. Activities are given as two arrays: start[] and finish[].
description.hi: Tumhe N activities di hain unke start aur finish times ke saath. Maximum kitni activities select kar sakte ho jo ek person kar sakta hai, ye maante hue ki ek person ek waqt mein sirf ek activity kar sakta hai. Activities do arrays mein di hain: start[] aur finish[].

explanation.en: Select activities at indices 0, 1, 3, 4 -> (1,2), (3,4), (5,7), (8,9). Maximum 4 non-overlapping activities.
explanation.hi: Indices 0, 1, 3, 4 wali activities select karo -> (1,2), (3,4), (5,7), (8,9). Maximum 4 non-overlapping activities.

explanation.en: All activities overlap with each other. Only one can be selected.
explanation.hi: Saari activities ek dusre se overlap karti hain. Sirf ek select ho sakti hai.

hints.en: Sort activities by their finish time
hints.hi: Activities ko finish time se sort karo

hints.en: Greedily pick the activity that finishes earliest and is compatible with the last selected one
hints.hi: Greedy tarike se wo activity chuno jo sabse pehle khatam ho aur last selected activity se compatible ho

description.en: Given weights and values of N items, put these items in a knapsack of capacity W to get the maximum total value. You can break items (take fractions of items). Print the maximum value with 2 decimal places.
description.hi: N items ke weights aur values diye hain, inhe W capacity ke knapsack mein daalo taaki maximum total value mile. Tum items ko tod sakte ho (fractions le sakte ho). Maximum value 2 decimal places tak print karo.

explanation.en: Take item 1 fully (value=60, weight=10), item 2 fully (value=100, weight=20), and 2/3 of item 3 (value=80, weight=20). Total = 60+100+80 = 240.00
explanation.hi: Item 1 poora lo (value=60, weight=10), item 2 poora lo (value=100, weight=20), aur item 3 ka 2/3 lo (value=80, weight=20). Total = 60+100+80 = 240.00

hints.en: Calculate value/weight ratio for each item
hints.hi: Har item ka value/weight ratio calculate karo

hints.en: Sort by ratio in descending order and greedily pick items
hints.hi: Ratio ke descending order mein sort karo aur greedily items pick karo

description.en: Given a string of characters and their frequencies, build a Huffman Tree and print the Huffman codes for each character. Print codes in sorted order of characters. If there is only one unique character, its code should be '0'.
description.hi: Characters aur unki frequencies di hain, Huffman Tree banao aur har character ke Huffman codes print karo. Codes characters ke sorted order mein print karo. Agar sirf ek unique character hai to uska code '0' hona chahiye.

explanation.en: Building the Huffman Tree: merge a(5)+b(9)=14, merge c(12)+d(13)=25, merge 14+25=39. Traverse the tree to get codes.
explanation.hi: Huffman Tree banate hain: a(5)+b(9)=14 merge karo, c(12)+d(13)=25 merge karo, 14+25=39 merge karo. Tree traverse karke codes nikalo.

hints.en: Use a min-heap (priority queue) to always pick two nodes with minimum frequency
hints.hi: Min-heap (priority queue) use karo taaki hamesha do minimum frequency wale nodes pick ho

hints.en: The greedy choice is to merge the two least frequent nodes first
hints.hi: Greedy choice hai ki do sabse kam frequent nodes ko pehle merge karo

hints.en: Left edge = 0, Right edge = 1. Traverse tree to generate codes.
hints.hi: Left edge = 0, Right edge = 1. Codes generate karne ke liye tree traverse karo.

description.en: Given a weighted, undirected, and connected graph with V vertices and E edges, find the sum of weights of the edges in the Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) using Kruskal's algorithm.
description.hi: Ek weighted, undirected, connected graph diya hai jisme V vertices aur E edges hain. Kruskal's algorithm use karke Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) ke edges ka total weight nikalo.

explanation.en: MST edges: (2,3,4) + (0,3,5) + (0,1,10) = 19. We pick edges in order of weight, skipping those that form cycles.
explanation.hi: MST edges: (2,3,4) + (0,3,5) + (0,1,10) = 19. Weight ke order mein edges pick karte hain, cycle banane wale skip karte hain.

hints.en: Sort all edges by weight in ascending order
hints.hi: Saare edges ko weight ke ascending order mein sort karo

hints.en: Use Union-Find (Disjoint Set Union) to detect cycles efficiently
hints.hi: Cycles detect karne ke liye Union-Find (Disjoint Set Union) use karo

code.python:
def kruskal_mst(V, edges):
    parent = list(range(V))
    rank = [0]*V
    def find(x):
        while parent[x]!=x: parent[x]=parent[parent[x]]; x=parent[x]
        return x
    def union(x,y):
        px,py=find(x),find(y)
        if px==py: return False
        if rank[px]<rank[py]: px,py=py,px
        parent[py]=px
        if rank[px]==rank[py]: rank[px]+=1
        return True
    edges.sort()
    mst=0
    for w,u,v in edges:
        if union(u,v): mst+=w
    return mst

description.en: Given a weighted, undirected, and connected graph with V vertices and E edges, find the sum of weights of the edges in the Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) using Prim's algorithm.
description.hi: Ek weighted, undirected, connected graph diya hai jisme V vertices aur E edges hain. Prim's algorithm use karke Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) ke edges ka total weight nikalo.

explanation.en: Starting from vertex 0: pick edge (0,1,2), then (1,2,3), then (1,4,5), then (0,3,6). Total MST weight = 2+3+5+6 = 16.
explanation.hi: Vertex 0 se shuru: edge (0,1,2) lo, phir (1,2,3), phir (1,4,5), phir (0,3,6). Total MST weight = 2+3+5+6 = 16.

hints.en: Use a min-heap (priority queue) to always pick the minimum weight edge connecting MST to non-MST vertices
hints.hi: Min-heap (priority queue) use karo taaki hamesha minimum weight edge mile jo MST ko non-MST vertices se connect kare

hints.en: Maintain a visited/inMST array to track which vertices are already in MST
hints.hi: Visited/inMST array maintain karo taaki pata rahe kaunse vertices MST mein hain

approach.en: Start from vertex 0. Use a min-heap storing (weight, vertex). Extract minimum, mark as visited, add weight to MST. Push all adjacent unvisited edges to heap.
approach.hi: Vertex 0 se shuru karo. Min-heap use karo (weight, vertex) store karke. Minimum extract karo, visited mark karo, weight MST mein add karo. Adjacent unvisited edges heap mein push karo.

description.en: Given a set of N jobs where each job has a deadline and a profit. Each job takes 1 unit of time. Only one job can be scheduled at a time. A job earns profit only if it is completed before or on its deadline. Find the maximum number of jobs that can be completed and the maximum profit.
description.hi: N jobs ka set diya hai jisme har job ki ek deadline aur profit hai. Har job 1 unit time leta hai. Ek waqt mein sirf ek job schedule ho sakti hai. Job ka profit tabhi milta hai jab wo deadline pe ya usse pehle complete ho. Maximum kitni jobs complete ho sakti hain aur maximum profit kya hai, ye nikalo.

N = 4
Jobs: {id:1, deadline:4, profit:20}, {id:2, deadline:1, profit:10}, {id:3, deadline:1, profit:40}, {id:4, deadline:1, profit:30}

explanation.en: Schedule job 3 (profit=40) at time 1, and job 1 (profit=20) at time 4. Max profit = 40+20 = 60 with 2 jobs.
explanation.hi: Job 3 (profit=40) time 1 pe schedule karo, aur job 1 (profit=20) time 4 pe. Max profit = 40+20 = 60, 2 jobs ke saath.

hints.en: Sort jobs by profit in descending order
hints.hi: Jobs ko profit ke descending order mein sort karo

hints.en: For each job, try to schedule it as late as possible (closest to deadline)
hints.hi: Har job ko jitna late ho sake schedule karo (deadline ke sabse paas)

description.en: Given N sorted files of different sizes, merge them into a single file with minimum total computation cost. When two files of sizes m and n are merged, the cost of the merge is m+n. Find the minimum total cost to merge all files.
description.hi: N sorted files di hain alag alag sizes ki, inhe ek file mein merge karo minimum total computation cost ke saath. Jab do files sizes m aur n ki merge hoti hain to cost m+n hota hai. Saari files merge karne ka minimum total cost nikalo.

explanation.en: Merge 2+3=5 (cost 5), merge 4+5=9 (cost 9), merge 5+9=14 (cost 14). Total = 5+9+14 = 28. But optimal: merge 2+3=5 (cost 5), merge 5+4=9 (cost 9), merge 9+5=14 (cost 14) => total still check: Actually merge 2+3=5 cost=5, then 5+4=9 cost=9, then 9+5=14 cost=14, total=28. OR: 2+3=5 cost=5, 4+5=9 cost=9, 5+9=14 cost=14, total=28. Correct answer is 29 when sizes are {2,3,4,5}: merge 2+3=5 cost=5, 4+5=9 cost=9, 5+9=14 cost=14+1=29? No. Let me recompute. Merge 2+3=5(cost=5). Now {4,5,5}. Merge 4+5=9(cost=9). Now {5,9}. Merge 5+9=14(cost=14). Total=5+9+14=28.
explanation.hi: Merge 2+3=5 (cost 5). Ab {4,5,5}. Merge 4+5=9 (cost 9). Ab {5,9}. Merge 5+9=14 (cost 14). Total = 5+9+14 = 28.

hints.en: Always merge the two smallest files first - this is the greedy choice
hints.hi: Hamesha do sabse chhoti files ko pehle merge karo - ye greedy choice hai

hints.en: Use a min-heap to efficiently get the two smallest files
hints.hi: Do sabse chhoti files efficiently nikalne ke liye min-heap use karo

approach.en: Use a min-heap. Repeatedly extract two minimum elements, merge them (sum), add the merge cost to total, and insert the merged value back. Repeat until one element remains.
approach.hi: Min-heap use karo. Baar baar do minimum elements nikalo, merge karo (sum), merge cost total mein add karo, aur merged value wapas daalo. Jab tak ek element na bache repeat karo.

code.python:
def optimal_merge(sizes, n):
    heapq.heapify(sizes)
    total_cost = 0
    while len(sizes) > 1:
        a = heapq.heappop(sizes)
        b = heapq.heappop(sizes)
        merged = a + b
        total_cost += merged
        heapq.heappush(sizes, merged)
    return total_cost

description.en: Given a weighted, directed graph with V vertices and E edges, and a source vertex S, find the shortest distance from S to all other vertices. If a vertex is unreachable, its distance should be -1. All edge weights are non-negative.
description.hi: Ek weighted, directed graph diya hai jisme V vertices aur E edges hain, aur ek source vertex S hai. S se baaki sabhi vertices tak shortest distance nikalo. Agar koi vertex unreachable hai to uski distance -1 honi chahiye. Saare edge weights non-negative hain.

explanation.hi: Vertex 0 se shortest distances: 0 tak=0, 1 tak=2 (0->1), 2 tak=3 (0->1->2), 3 tak=9 (0->1->3), 4 tak=6 (0->1->2->4).

hints.en: Use a min-heap to always process the vertex with smallest tentative distance
hints.hi: Min-heap use karo taaki hamesha sabse chhoti tentative distance wala vertex process ho

hints.en: Relax all edges from the current vertex and update distances if shorter path found
hints.hi: Current vertex ke saare edges relax karo aur agar chhota path mile to distances update karo

approach.en: Initialize all distances to infinity except source (0). Use a min-heap. Extract vertex with minimum distance, relax all its neighbors. If new distance is shorter, update and push to heap.
approach.hi: Source ke alawa saari distances infinity initialize karo. Min-heap use karo. Minimum distance wala vertex extract karo, saare neighbors relax karo. Agar naya distance chhota hai to update karo aur heap mein push karo.
